# realizes

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:realizes`](gmeow-realizes.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/realizes>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)

Relates an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) to the [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) it realizes. Non-functional: an omnibus or aggregate [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) may realize multiple Works (e.g. an anthology). Inverse of [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](gmeow-realizedThrough.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) -> [`gmeow:Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md)
